class _Rules(Rules):
    """RewardNoise (O axis, harder with DOSE): perturb the observed reward by adding a zero-mean
    noise term whose magnitude grows with DOSE. The world and observations are untouched, so the
    task remains solvable; only the reward signal becomes noisier."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def _noise(self, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return ((int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) / 10000.0 - 0.5) * 2.0 * self.DOSE

    def modify_transition(self, action, raw_response, env_state):
        return EnvResponse(
            observation=raw_response.observation,
            reward=raw_response.reward + self._noise(env_state),
            terminated=raw_response.terminated,
            truncated=raw_response.truncated,
            info=raw_response.info,
        )

import random


class _Rules(Rules):
    """ObservationNoiseInsertion (O axis, harder with DOSE): insert a deterministic-looking
    distracting line into the observation text. At DOSE=0 no insertion; at higher DOSE more
    junk tokens are inserted before the admissible-commands footer. The world is untouched, so
    the task stays solvable. Uses a DOSE-scaled seed so perturbation is reproducible."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__

    _JUNK = [
        "(note: a previous attempt was interrupted)",
        "reminder: double-check the last command",
        "[system] cache miss",
        "hint ignored: token expired",
        "(the environment emitted a spurious event)",
    ]

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        if self.DOSE <= 0:
            return obs
        text = obs.text
        n = int(round(self.DOSE * len(self._JUNK)))
        if n <= 0:
            return obs
        rng = random.Random(int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0) * 7919 + 13)
        junk_lines = "\n".join(rng.choice(self._JUNK) for _ in range(n))
        cut = text.find("\n\nAdmissible commands: ")
        if cut >= 0:
            text = text[:cut] + "\n" + junk_lines + text[cut:]
        else:
            text = text + "\n" + junk_lines
        return Observation(text=text, data=obs.data)

import hashlib


class _Rules(Rules):
    """CommandPermuteMask (O axis, harder with DOSE): deterministically permute the order of the
    admissible-commands list in the footer, so a policy that relies on positional indexing of the
    command list gets misled. The permutation is fixed per (task_id, step, DOSE-bucket), and the
    set of steps permuted grows with DOSE (nested). The world is untouched, so it is solvable by
    construction (commands are still present, just reordered)."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def _permuted(self, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return (int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) < int(self.DOSE * 10000)

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        if not self._permuted(env_state):
            return obs
        text = obs.text
        marker = "\n\nAdmissible commands: "
        cut = text.find(marker)
        if cut < 0:
            return obs
        head = text[:cut + len(marker)]
        tail = text[cut + len(marker):]
        # Split into lines; keep blank lines out of the permutation.
        lines = tail.splitlines()
        items = [ln for ln in lines if ln.strip()]
        if len(items) < 2:
            return obs
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"perm:{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        seed = int(digest[:8], 16)
        order = list(range(len(items)))
        rng = seed
        for i in range(len(items) - 1, 0, -1):
            rng = (rng * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
            j = rng % (i + 1)
            order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
        permuted = [items[i] for i in order]
        new_tail = "\n".join(permuted)
        return Observation(text=head + new_tail, data=dict(obs.data or {}))

import hashlib


class _Rules(Rules):
    """FooterRewrite (O axis, harder with DOSE): instead of removing the admissible-commands
    footer, replace it with a misleading footer. At each step, with probability DOSE the footer
    is replaced by a shuffled list of commands (same set, wrong order) plus one decoy command
    chosen deterministically from a fixed pool. The world is untouched, so the task stays
    solvable by construction; the model must not blindly trust the footer ordering."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__
    DECOYS = ("wait", "examine", "inventory")

    def _corrupt(self, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return (int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) < int(self.DOSE * 10000)

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        if not self._corrupt(env_state):
            return obs
        text = obs.text
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        cmds = data.get("admissible_commands")
        if cmds is None:
            marker = "\n\nAdmissible commands: "
            cut = text.find(marker)
            if cut < 0:
                return obs
            body = text[cut + len(marker):]
            cmds = [c.strip() for c in body.split(",") if c.strip()]
        if not cmds:
            return obs
        decoy = self.DECOYS[int(int(hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:d:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % len(self.DECOYS))]
        shuffled = list(cmds)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:s:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        shuffled.sort(key=lambda c: hashlib.sha256((digest + c).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())
        fake = shuffled + [decoy]
        new_footer = "\n\nAdmissible commands: " + ", ".join(fake)
        if "\n\nAdmissible commands: " in text:
            cut = text.find("\n\nAdmissible commands: ")
            text = text[:cut] + new_footer
        else:
            text = text + new_footer
        data["admissible_commands"] = fake
        return Observation(text=text, data=data)

class _Rules(Rules):
    """RewardEcho (A axis, harder with DOSE): the reward channel becomes noisy. With probability
    DOSE at each non-terminal step, the reward is replaced by a constant decoy value (0) and an
    extra info flag is set. True reward is still delivered on success/termination, so the optimal
    policy is unchanged; the model must ignore misleading intermediate rewards."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def modify_transition(self, action, raw_response, env_state):
        if raw_response.terminated or raw_response.truncated:
            return raw_response
        if raw_response.info.get("success") is True or bool(getattr(env_state, "won", False)):
            return raw_response
        import hashlib
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        if (int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) < int(self.DOSE * 10000):
            return EnvResponse(
                observation=raw_response.observation,
                reward=0.0,
                terminated=False,
                truncated=False,
                info={**raw_response.info, "reward_echo": True},
            )
        return raw_response

class _Rules(Rules):
    """CommandWhitelistDrop (O axis, harder with DOSE): randomly drop a fraction DOSE of the
    admissible commands listed in the footer. The world is untouched, so the task stays solvable
    as long as at least one admissible command survives at every step; we therefore cap the
    dropped fraction so one command always remains. The dropped set is drawn deterministically
    per (task, step) so it is nested in DOSE."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        cmds = (obs.data or {}).get("admissible_commands")
        if not cmds:
            return obs
        # deterministic per-step ordering
        order = sorted(cmds, key=lambda c: hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}:{c}".encode()).hexdigest())
        keep = max(1, int(round(len(order) * (1.0 - self.DOSE))))
        kept = set(order[:keep])
        new_cmds = [c for c in cmds if c in kept]
        text = obs.text
        cut = text.find("\n\nAdmissible commands: ")
        if cut >= 0:
            head = text[:cut]
            text = head + "\n\nAdmissible commands: " + ", ".join(new_cmds)
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        data["admissible_commands"] = new_cmds
        return Observation(text=text, data=data)

import hashlib


class _Rules(Rules):
    """AdmissibleShuffle (O axis, harder with DOSE): shuffle the order of the admissible-commands
    footer deterministically on a fraction DOSE of steps. The set of commands is preserved and the
    world is untouched, so the task remains solvable. bucket = sha256(f"{task_id}:{step}:shuffle")[:8]
    % 10000; shuffled iff bucket < DOSE * 10000 (nested in DOSE)."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def _shuffled(self, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}:shuffle".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return (int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) < int(self.DOSE * 10000)

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        if not self._shuffled(env_state):
            return obs
        text = obs.text
        marker = "\n\nAdmissible commands: "
        cut = text.find(marker)
        if cut < 0:
            return obs
        head = text[:cut]
        footer = text[cut + len(marker):]
        lines = footer.split("\n")
        # deterministic permutation of the command lines
        ordered = sorted(range(len(lines)), key=lambda i: hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}:{i}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())
        shuffled = "\n".join(lines[i] for i in ordered)
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        cmds = data.get("admissible_commands")
        if isinstance(cmds, list):
            data["admissible_commands"] = [cmds[i] for i in ordered if i < len(cmds)]
        return Observation(text=head + marker + shuffled, data=data)

class _Rules(Rules):
    """ActionAliasSwap (A axis, harder with DOSE): at a deterministic fraction DOSE of the
    steps, the admissible commands are presented with a random-looking but fixed permutation of
    their text labels (the underlying action semantics are preserved via a lookup). The world is
    untouched, so the task stays solvable; higher DOSE masks more steps."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def _masked(self, env_state):
        import hashlib
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return (int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) < int(self.DOSE * 10000)

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        if not self._masked(env_state):
            return obs
        cmds = (obs.data or {}).get("admissible_commands")
        if not cmds:
            return obs
        # deterministic shuffle keyed by step
        import hashlib
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        key = int(hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:shuffle:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
        order = sorted(range(len(cmds)), key=lambda i: (key * (i + 1)) % 1000003)
        aliased = [cmds[i] for i in order]
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        data["admissible_commands"] = aliased
        return Observation(text=obs.text, data=data)

class _Rules(Rules):
    """RewardPenalty (A axis, harder with DOSE): subtract a deterministic DOSE-scaled penalty
    from the step reward on a nested set of steps, leaving the world and observations untouched.
    Task solvability is unaffected (success still yields its own reward)."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__

    def modify_transition(self, action, raw_response, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        # nested step set via hash bucket
        import hashlib
        tid = getattr(self, "TASK_ID", "0")
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{tid}:{step}:pen".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        if (int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) < int(self.DOSE * 10000):
            penalty = float(self.DOSE) * 0.5
            return EnvResponse(
                observation=raw_response.observation,
                reward=raw_response.reward - penalty,
                terminated=raw_response.terminated,
                truncated=raw_response.truncated,
                info={**raw_response.info, "reward_penalty": penalty},
            )
        return raw_response

import hashlib


class _Rules(Rules):
    """CommandNoiseSwap (O axis, harder with DOSE): with probability DOSE, swap two random
    characters within each admissible command string shown in the footer. The world and the
    actual accepted commands are untouched, so the task stays solvable by construction; the
    policy must visually decode the scrambled commands. Swaps are deterministic per step via
    sha256 so the perturbation is reproducible."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def _swap(self, s, seed):
        if len(s) < 2:
            return s
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{seed}:{s}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        i = int(digest[:8], 16) % len(s)
        j = int(digest[8:16], 16) % len(s)
        if i == j:
            j = (j + 1) % len(s)
        lst = list(s)
        lst[i], lst[j] = lst[j], lst[i]
        return "".join(lst)

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        bucket = int(hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 10000
        if bucket >= int(self.DOSE * 10000):
            return obs
        cmds = (obs.data or {}).get("admissible_commands")
        if not cmds:
            return obs
        new_cmds = [self._swap(c, f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}:{idx}") for idx, c in enumerate(cmds)]
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        data["admissible_commands"] = new_cmds
        text = obs.text
        for old, new in zip(cmds, new_cmds):
            text = text.replace(old, new)
        return Observation(text=text, data=data)

import random


class _Rules(Rules):
    """CommandPermutation (O axis, harder with DOSE): permute the order of the admissible
    commands list in the footer. At DOSE=0 the order is unchanged; as DOSE grows the
    permutation becomes a larger derangement (a fixed shuffle seeded by DOSE), so the policy
    must read commands rather than rely on positional memory. The world is untouched, so it is
    solvable by construction."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        text = obs.text
        marker = "\n\nAdmissible commands: "
        cut = text.find(marker)
        if cut < 0:
            return obs
        head = text[:cut + len(marker)]
        body = text[cut + len(marker):]
        commands = [c.strip() for c in body.split(",") if c.strip()]
        if len(commands) <= 1:
            return obs
        rng = random.Random(int(self.DOSE * 1000000))
        order = list(range(len(commands)))
        rng.shuffle(order)
        if self.DOSE <= 0.0:
            order = list(range(len(commands)))
        shuffled = [commands[i] for i in order]
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        if "admissible_commands" in data:
            ac = list(data["admissible_commands"])
            if len(ac) == len(commands):
                data["admissible_commands"] = [ac[i] for i in order]
        return Observation(text=head + ", ".join(shuffled), data=data)

import random


class _Rules(Rules):
    """NoiseObservations (O axis, harder with DOSE): inject random non-command tokens into the
    observation text at a deterministic fraction DOSE of steps. The injected tokens are clearly
    marked (e.g. 'IGNORE:xxxx') and never appear in the admissible commands, so a robust policy
    can ignore them. World is untouched, solvable by construction."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        rng = random.Random(hash((self.TASK_ID, step)) & 0xffffffff)
        if rng.random() >= self.DOSE:
            return obs
        text = obs.text
        token = "IGNORE:%08x" % rng.getrandbits(32)
        if "\n\nAdmissible commands: " in text:
            head, sep, foot = text.partition("\n\nAdmissible commands: ")
            text = head + "\n[note: " + token + "]\n" + sep + foot
        else:
            text = text + "\n[note: " + token + "]"
        return Observation(text=text, data=obs.data)

import hashlib


class _Rules(Rules):
    """CommandPermutation (O axis, harder with DOSE): permute the order of the
    admissible-commands footer deterministically. At DOSE=0 the footer order is
    unchanged; as DOSE grows, an increasingly large prefix of the command list is
    rotated so the correct command is displaced. The command *set* is untouched, so
    the task stays solvable."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def _rot(self, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000

    def filter_observation(self, obs, env_state):
        text = obs.text
        marker = "\n\nAdmissible commands: "
        cut = text.find(marker)
        if cut < 0:
            return obs
        head = text[:cut + len(marker)]
        tail = text[cut + len(marker):]
        cmds = [c for c in tail.split("\n") if c.strip()]
        if len(cmds) < 2:
            return obs
        k = int(self.DOSE * len(cmds))
        if k <= 0:
            return obs
        # rotate the first k commands left by one; correct command still present
        rotated = cmds[1:k] + [cmds[0]] + cmds[k:]
        data = dict(obs.data or {})
        if "admissible_commands" in data and isinstance(data["admissible_commands"], list):
            ac = list(data["admissible_commands"])
            if len(ac) >= 2:
                kk = int(self.DOSE * len(ac))
                if kk > 0:
                    ac = ac[1:kk] + [ac[0]] + ac[kk:]
                    data["admissible_commands"] = ac
        return Observation(text=head + "\n".join(rotated), data=data)

import hashlib


class _Rules(Rules):
    """RewardNoise (A axis, harder with DOSE): add a deterministic, step-dependent
    perturbation to the reward so the scale of spurious reward grows with DOSE.
    The success signal is never altered, so the task is still solvable."""

    DOSE = __DOSE__
    TASK_ID = __TASK_ID__

    def _noise(self, env_state):
        step = int(getattr(env_state, "step_count", 0) or 0)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{self.TASK_ID}:{step}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        v = (int(digest[:8], 16) % 10000) / 10000.0  # [0,1)
        return (v - 0.5) * self.DOSE

    def modify_transition(self, action, raw_response, env_state):
        noise = self._noise(env_state)
        if isinstance(raw_response.reward, (int, float)):
            return EnvResponse(
                observation=raw_response.observation,
                reward=raw_response.reward + noise,
                terminated=raw_response.terminated,
                truncated=raw_response.truncated,
                info=raw_response.info,
            )
        return raw_response
